viewing_check: Ask staff to power it on and confirm the display lights and fan spins; if water can be run through, check the compressor starts (it won't run without flow). Check the fins are straight and uncorroded, titanium exchanger ports clean, no oil stains at pipe joints (refrigerant leak), and that the WiFi module/controller and cable are present. Confirm the box has the bypass valve, check valve and unions shown.
